note: Both sets extract the same two figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336º) and both contain redundant duplicate claims. Set A invents a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' entity that appears nowhere on the page and binds pitch sensitivity to the blade-pitch axis rather than the turbine/power quantity. Set B correctly attributes the regression results to the NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine named in the text, but mislabels θK = 6.302336º as the 'best-fit line intercept' when the text defines θK as the blade-pitch angle where pitch sensitivity has doubled (the intercept is ∂P/∂θ at θ=0).
